breakdown.description: The nearly incompressible plane-strain problem is switched from a mixed displacement-pressure (u-p) formulation to a displacement-only solve
breakdown.reason: The generated specification failed to resolve the inconsistency. While it initially mentions using a 'mixed formulation', it later explicitly includes the incorrect instruction from the original prompt: 'Do not include a separate pressure field; rely on the displacement-based formulation with plane strain to handle near-incompressibility.' The ground truth corrects this by stating that a mixed displacement-pressure formulation is required precisely because the material is nearly incompressible (ν is close to 0.5).
